headline_findings: All 14 current weak-row comeback entries are direct `ProbeSpec` loads, so the future Rust lane does not have to spend its first pass on wrapper/template translation before adding tests.
The comeback surface is smaller than the raw queue implies: 14 queue rows collapse into 10 generated bundles, saving 4 repeated rows.
The clean first plateau is still shard prefix 6: it lands every `lift_first` row in 164 added lines without touching the final dual-lane shard.
Shard prefix 7 is the first point that reaches any `externalize_now` row and also the best marginal value prefix at 0.06452 rows per added line.
The monolithic patch and the 10-shard cumulative series were rehearsal-applied to scratch copies and finished with identical target-file states (`final_state_equivalent=True`).
